annotation.title_clean: Responsible Innovation: Israel's Policy on Artificial Intelligence Regulation and Ethics
annotation.title_en: Responsible Innovation: Israel's Policy on Artificial Intelligence Regulation and Ethics
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Israel Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology; Ministry of Justice (Office of Legal Counsel and Legislative Affairs)
annotation.venue: Israel Ministry of Innovation, Science and Technology
annotation.summary_en: English summary of Israel's December 2023 AI regulation and ethics policy for the private sector. It favours sector-specific regulators, soft regulation, a risk-based approach, sandboxes and OECD-aligned principles over horizontal legislation, and proposes an AI Policy Coordination Center and a risk management tool.
key_provisions_or_claims: Six regulatory principles: sectoral regulators, interoperability, risk-based, incremental/experimentation, soft regulation, multistakeholder cooperation.
Adopt non-binding ethical AI principles based on the OECD AI Principles.
Establish an AI Policy Coordination Center under the Ministry of Innovation with Ministry of Justice.
Map AI uses in regulated sectors and create regulator and multistakeholder forums.
Develop a government risk management tool and engage in international standards forums.
